02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curiosity is
my starting point.

I like understanding how things work.
Then figuring out how to make them better.

I’m Abinash Rajasagaram, a Software Engineering undergraduate at Universiti Putra Malaysia. My interests sit where backend systems, artificial intelligence, and the physical world meet.

I enjoy building the whole picture—from the data and APIs behind an application to the experience people actually use. Outside of code, I lead technical teams and volunteer in community programmes.
